subject: Request: No-PO path for small-dollar pilot - Acme Merchant
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: No-PO path for small-dollar pilot - Acme Merchant

Team —

Quick ask: Acme Merchant (external) has requested a 60–90 day pilot to integrate Redwood for their checkout fraud review. Expected spend is small (estimated ~$3k/month) but we need to move fast to demo before their board next month.

Proposal: grant a temporary no-PO onboarding path for this pilot with the following guardrails:
- Duration: 90 days or $10k lifetime cap (whichever comes first)
- Invoicing: vendor invoices paid on receipt (Net 30) via AP, routed to laura.bennett@redwood.com
- Controls: vendor completes onboarding form + W-9, limited access token scoped to sandbox data only

Attachments: Acme_Onboarding_Form.pdf (filled) included.

Can Procurement + Finance sign off on a short no-PO exception so we can get their first invoice and start the pilot this week? If we can’t, we’ll need to wait for a vendor record + PO which adds 2–3 weeks.

Thanks — Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 10:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: No-PO path for small-dollar pilot - Acme Merchant

Rafael —

Thanks for the context and the filled onboarding form. A couple of items Procurement needs before we can approve a no-PO exception:
1) Confirmation of vendor legal name, remit address, and W-9 (for US vendors) — please ask Acme to send.
2) A short risk note from sales listing the data types involved (you indicated sandbox, please confirm no production PII).
3) Proposed payment terms and cap (you suggested $10k cap — fine as long as Finance signs off).

If we get the W-9 and confirmation that the pilot will not touch production customer data, Procurement can provisionally approve an exception for 90 days. We will log an exception ticket (PROC-1182) and require AP to route the actual invoice to Laura for payment.

Please get the vendor to send the W-9 and sample invoice (PDF). Ill add the exception to our tracker once we have those items.

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Mar 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: No-PO path for small-dollar pilot - Acme Merchant

All —

Finance is prepared to grant a conditional no-PO pathway for this pilot with these constraints:
- Monthly cap: $5,000 (we wont process invoices above this without an approved PO)
- Duration: 90 days maximum; Finance will review at day 60 for extension
- Invoice routing: AP to Laura Bennett (laura.bennett@redwood.com) with "ACME PILOT" in memo line
- Payment terms: Net 30 as requested

Procurement must register the vendor record in our vendor system within the pilot window. Marcus sign-off assumes vendor passed basic onboarding (W-9 received, no production data). If Procurement confirms vendor registration will take longer than 10 business days, we can still proceed under the exception but Finance will require a one-time manual payment request.

I'll loop in a quick check with Tax for the W-9; otherwise I'm ok to proceed.

From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: No-PO path for small-dollar pilot - Acme Merchant

Thanks everyone — quick status:
- Received W-9 and sample invoice from Acme (attached).
- Vendor confirms sandbox-only tokens and no production PII access.
- Finance (Marcus) agrees to conditional no-PO with $5k/month cap and 90-day limit.

Monica — can Procurement log PROC-1182 as an exception ticket and create a vendor record in the system (or confirm timeline to create)? If vendor registration will be delayed more than 10 business days, Laura will accept a manual payment request for the first invoice under the exception.

Sarah — Ive attached the onboarding form we received for reference. Well plan to start the pilot once Procurement confirms the exception is logged and AP has the sample invoice.

Next steps (agreed):
- Monica will log the exception ticket and update PROC-1182 with a vendor intake ETA (Procurement)
- Laura will confirm AP routing and hold request if registration slips beyond 10 business days (Finance)
- Rafael will share pilot kickoff notes with Acme and schedule technical onboarding

Thanks — Rafael

Attachments: Acme_Onboarding_Form.pdf, Acme_W9.pdf, Acme_Sample_Invoice_0320.pdf
